newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan to visit Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan to visit Gaza.

text.p: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan will visit Gaza on Monday for talks with Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat, officials said.
The visit follows a trip to Israel on Sunday by King Hussein of Jordan. The king and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke to Arafat by telephone during their meeting.
Officials gave no details of Crown Prince Hassan's trip to Gaza. Earlier this month the prince's office denied reports he was taking up a long-standing invitation to visit Israel.
